You can book your appointment online in just a few clicks:
👉 bit.ly/BirthRegistrationsBlackpool 

If you’re unable to proceed (for example, if your child is over 42 days old), don’t worry – just give us a call on 01253 477177 and our friendly team will help. ☎️
You can also email registrars.bdm@blackpool.gov.uk with your contact number, and someone will get back to you. 💬
📍 Appointments available on selected Mondays at Blackpool North Family Hub (limited spaces available, so book early!)
💳 You can pay for certificates at your appointment using a debit or credit card.

Join us for a friendly and refreshing walk designed especially for parents.

Spending time outdoors can lift your mood, boost your wellbeing, and offer a gentle reset to your day. Whether you’re looking for fresh air, a change of scenery, or a chance to connect with others. Supported by the wonderful team at Lancashire Women, this relaxed walk also provides a safe and understanding space if you’re experiencing anxiety, postnatal depression, or simply need a bit of extra support. You’ll be surrounded by people who get it, with no pressure. Just the opportunity to chat, walk, and feel part of something welcoming.

We meet at 9:45am at Stanley Park Visitor Centre - no need to book, just come along whenever you can.
For more information, you can text our Parent Carer Coordinator, Hannah, on 07385 002813.

Have you and your family experienced neonatal unit support as part of your journey into parenthood?

You are warmly invited to join us for a relaxed monthly coffee morning at Blackpool North Family Hub. This is a friendly, informal space for families to come together, share experiences, meet others who may understand, and access gentle support.

The session will start in July and will be held on the 1st Tuesday of every month, from 10:00am to 11:30am.
The coffee morning will be run by Family Hubs and Lancashire Women Charity.
 
Whether your neonatal experience is recent or you are still navigating its impact, you are very welcome to come along for a cuppa, a chat, and support at your own pace.
